title: Spiced Pork Gyoza
description: A fusion twist on traditional Japanese gyoza, filled with spiced pork and served pan-fried to perfection.
instructions: 1. Preheat a large skillet or wok over medium-high heat.
2. In a small bowl, mix together soy sauce, ginger, and sesame oil.
3. Add the soy sauce mixture to the ground pork and mix until just combined.
4. Lay a gyoza wrapper on a clean surface and place a tablespoon of the pork mixture in the center.
5. Brush the edges of the wrapper with a little water and fold the wrapper into a triangle, pressing the edges to seal.
6. Repeat with remaining wrappers and filling.
7. Heat a tablespoon of sesame oil in the preheated skillet and add the gyoza, seam-side down.
8. Pan-fry for 2-3 minutes on each side, until the gyoza are golden brown and crispy.
9. Serve the gyoza hot with soy sauce and sesame seeds for garnish.
